summary: Iteration 45: Tested chart fixes, Income vs Expenses overview card, and Smart Receipt upload system. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working with all new features.

issues: Labels are truncated at 14 characters (shows '...' for long category names like 'Commandants...'). This is intentional per code but may affect readability for some categories.
